P01.rationale: A large, full-bleed portrait of the founder dominates the upper half of the page, serving as a clear human anchor.

P05.rationale: No case study client portraits are present; the page contains no named client images at any size.

P07.rationale: There is no press/logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial apparatus anywhere on the page.

P10.rationale: No oversized ghost numerals or large decorative quote glyphs are used as typographic decoration.

P11.rationale: The two statistics (100+ and 30-50%) are presented as plain text callouts with no chart, before/after graphic, or data visualisation.

P12.rationale: The upper half is well-filled by the portrait and the lower half carries a large headline and bullet list, but the transition zone between them leaves a noticeable empty band, reducing overall density.

P13.rationale: The dark, moody photographic background provides atmospheric texture in the upper section, though the lower content area sits on a flat dark surface with no texture.

P14.rationale: The full-bleed portrait photo is darkened with a strong scrim/vignette so that all overlaid text and stat callouts remain clearly legible.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The portrait appears to be a specific, professionally shot individual rather than an obvious stock photo, lending reasonable authenticity.

N08.rationale: A large empty band exists between the bottom edge of the photo and the start of the headline/body copy section, creating noticeable dead whitespace.

N10.rationale: The stat callouts sit directly over the dark photo but the scrim keeps them readable; there are no awkward inset gaps, though the placement is slightly tight against the portrait.
